rules.statement: The defendant's title was superior due to the equitable right created by Carry's sale in 1909, which, upon confirmation of legal title from the Crown grant in 1912, gave the purchaser an indefeasible claim.
rules.supporting_quote: "Carry's sale in 1909 created an equitable right, a right which, by Roman-Dutch law, on confirmation by subsequent acquisition of legal title, gave the purchaser in possession an indefeasible claim"
